create_gemini_llm_instance: create a GeminiLLM instance with an API key and model name like gemini-1.5-flash
generate_gemini_response: generate a response from Gemini by passing a list of message dictionaries to the generate method
count_tokens_gemini: count tokens in a text string using the GeminiLLM internal tokenizer with cl100k_base encoding
convert_messages_to_gemini_format: convert standard role-based messages to Gemini-specific format with user and model roles
format_gemini_message: format a message dictionary with role and content keys for use with the GeminiLLM generate method
